payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): Caveats
payload.what: - The epilogue can only read TMEM after the MMA for that tile is complete. The double-buffer synchronization is mandatory to prevent reading partial results. - TMEM-to-register bandwidth is not unlimited. With 14 warps simultaneously reading TMEM, each warp gets a proportional share. Very wide output tiles (large TILE_N) may bottleneck on TMEM read bandwidth. - Simple epilogues (just store) waste the 14 epilogue warps. For such cases, consider reducing the CTA size or assigning epilogue warps to other work (e.g., next-tile TMA prefetch).
